=== a 32-bit syscall program
        global _start
        section .text
_start:
        mov     eax, 4
        mov     ebx, 1
        mov     ecx, msg
        mov     edx, msglen
        int     0x80
        mov     eax, 1
        xor     ebx, ebx
        int     0x80
        section .data
msg:    db      "hi", 10
msglen  equ     $ - msg
=== data and symbols
        global x, y, f
        section .data
x:      dd      1
y:      dd      2
        section .text
f:      ret
        section .bss
        global buf
buf:    resd    4
=== externs and relocations
        extern printf
        extern value
        global main
        section .text
main:
        call    printf
        mov     eax, [value]
        push    dword value
        ret
        section .data
        dd      value
        dd      main
=== relative data and label differences
        section .text
a:      nop
b:      nop
        section .data
        dd      b - a
        dd      a
tab:    dd      a - tab
=== local labels
        section .text
        global f
f:
        jmp     .loop
.loop:
        jmp     .loop
        dd      f.loop - f
=== plt and got in pic
        extern ext
        global f
        section .text
f:
        call    ext wrt ..plt
        mov     eax, [ext wrt ..got]
        section .data
        dd      ext wrt ..sym
=== struc
        struc rec
        .a: resd 1
        .b: resd 1
        endstruc
        section .data
        global r
r:      istruc rec
        at rec.a, dd 1
        at rec.b, dd 2
        iend
        dd      rec_size
